settings.title: Return & Refund Policy
settings.subtitle: We want you to have a smooth and worry-free shopping experience.
settings.item_1_text: You can return products within 7 days of delivery. The product must be unused, unwashed, and in its original packaging.
settings.item_2_text: Once we receive and inspect the returned product, your refund will be processed within 5–7 business days.
settings.item_3_text: We offer exchanges for size or defective products, subject to availability.
settings.item_4_text: Certain items may not be eligible for return due to hygiene or special discounts.
settings.item_5_text: If you receive a damaged or incorrect product, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery.
